scope: Public-source metadata inventory for U.S. federal agencies, with focused coverage of CDC, FBI, U.S. Secret Service, CIA, and federal open-data infrastructure.
important_limit: This inventory catalogs publicly released dataset/document metadata and source systems. It does not collect classified, restricted, private-person, operational, investigative, intelligence-source, or internal telemetry data.

federal_catalog.name: Data.gov
federal_catalog.role: Central federal open-data metadata catalog; it provides metadata and links to agency-hosted datasets rather than hosting the underlying data files.
federal_catalog.standard: DCAT-US v3.0 is the current federal metadata standard documented by Data.gov for dataset, API, and data-service inventories.

CDC.privacy_boundary: CDC WONDER states that its datasets are for statistical reporting and analysis and prohibits attempts to identify individuals or linking data for identification purposes.

FBI.current_release_note: The FBI publishes UCR data monthly through the Crime Data Explorer; its 2025 First Look release was based on submissions from more than 17,000 agencies covering 96% of the population.

USSS.name: United States Secret Service
USSS.public_annual_report_structure: The FY2023 annual report organizes public accomplishments into Protective Operations, Investigative Operations, Training, and Mission Support and identifies offices including Strategic Intelligence and Information and Investigations.
USSS.security_boundary: Do not infer or catalog nonpublic protective details, current protective movements, vulnerabilities, operational procedures, investigative case data, or personnel-sensitive information.

CIA.public_release_boundary: CIA states that its Electronic Reading Room provides declassified documents and historical materials released through FOIA, while some information remains protected by national-security requirements.
CIA.research_rule: Use only information declassified or released through official U.S. Government channels; avoid intelligence sources/methods and operational details that are not officially released.

other_federal_agency_metadata.coverage_method: Use Data.gov organization catalogs and DCAT-US metadata to enumerate additional federal agencies and their public datasets rather than attempting to copy every underlying dataset.

pipeline: record source URL and retrieval date

status: Public federal-agency metadata source inventory prepared from official agency and federal open-data sources. It is a source map and schema, not a claim to possess every agency record or every underlying dataset.
